_comment: 130 Golden Walnut sources. track_type: A=individually trackable, B=aggregate trackable (counter), C=not individually trackable (visible only in total)

sources.label: Golden Coconut
sources.description: Bring a Golden Coconut to Clint. The first one he opens contains a Golden Walnut.

sources.label: Island Fishing
sources.description: Fishing anywhere on Ginger Island gives a 15% chance per cast for a Golden Walnut, up to 5 total.

sources.label: Jungle Bush (path to Leo's hut)
sources.description: A walnut in a bush on the path toward Leo's hut in the jungle.

sources.label: Banana Shrine Gorilla
sources.description: Place a Banana on the altar by the staircase to Leo's hut. A gorilla appears and gives 3 walnuts.

sources.label: Leo's Hut Tree
sources.description: Hit the tree inside Leo's hut with an axe.

sources.label: South of Gem Bird Shrine
sources.description: From Leo's hut stairs, follow the hidden eastern passage to the Gem Bird Shrine. A walnut sits south of the shrine.

sources.label: Gem Birds Puzzle
sources.description: Complete the Gem Birds puzzle by placing all four gems on the pedestals at the Island Shrine.

sources.label: Island Farm Crops
sources.description: Each crop harvested on Ginger Island has a 5% chance to yield a walnut (crops that don't regrow only). Up to 5 total.

sources.label: Gourmand Frog: Melon
sources.description: Talk to the Gourmand Frog in the cave south of the island farm. Grow a Melon and leave it for the frog to eat. Rewards 5 walnuts.

sources.label: Gourmand Frog: Wheat
sources.description: After the Melon, the Gourmand Frog asks for Wheat. Grow one and leave it. Rewards 5 walnuts.

sources.label: Gourmand Frog: Garlic
sources.description: After Wheat, the Gourmand Frog asks for Garlic. Grow one and leave it. Rewards 5 walnuts.

sources.label: Buried: SE Beach Corner
sources.description: Journal Scrap #6: Go south from the farm to the SE corner of the beach where there is a curved palm tree. Dig in the corner tile where the cliff meets the northern rock formation.

sources.label: Mussel Nodes
sources.description: Mining Mussel Nodes on the Island West beach has a 10% chance of yielding a walnut. Up to 5 total.

sources.label: Inside Shipwreck
sources.description: Find the shipwreck at the SW side of the beach south of the farm. Follow the hidden path at the west corner into the ship interior.

sources.label: Sand Duggy (Mole)
sources.description: Find the mole at the SE side of the beach south of Birdie's hut. Cover three holes with placeable objects to trap it, then whack it.

sources.label: Buried: Blue Starfish Triangle
sources.description: Find the blue starfish triangle on the beach south of the farm. Dig up the center.

sources.label: Buried: Starfish Diamond
sources.description: Find the starfish diamond near the tide pools (may be partially covered by a rock). Dig up the center.

sources.label: Buried: X in Sand (Tide Pools)
sources.description: Find the X marked in the sand in the tide pools. Dig up the center.

sources.label: Buried: Diamond Indents near Ocean
sources.description: Find a diamond of indents in the sand to the bottom-left of the tide pools, near the ocean. Dig up the center.

sources.label: Behind Coconut Tree (Pond)
sources.description: A walnut hidden behind a coconut tree by the pond west of the island farm.

sources.label: Pirate's Wife Quest (Birdie)
sources.description: Complete The Pirate's Wife quest by helping Birdie recover her husband's belongings. Rewards 5 walnuts.

sources.label: Buried: North of Birdie's Hut
sources.description: Journal Scrap #4: Dig in the sand north of Birdie's Hut to find a Quality Bobber and 1 Golden Walnut. (Digging yields nothing if you haven't read the journal scrap.)

sources.label: Bush near Qi's Walnut Room
sources.description: Walk up the western coast toward Qi's Walnut Room. Find a walnut bush to the bottom-right near a cliff.

sources.label: Bush in Ocean Past Qi's Room
sources.description: Walk up past Qi's Walnut Room through the ocean water to find a walnut bush.

sources.label: Tiger Slime Grove: Kill Slimes
sources.description: Killing slimes in the Tiger Slime Grove can yield one Golden Walnut total.

sources.label: Behind Mahogany Tree (Tiger Grove)
sources.description: Find the walnut behind a mahogany tree in the Tiger Slime Grove.

sources.label: Buried: Grass Circle in Tiger Grove
sources.description: Find a circle of grass in the Tiger Slime Grove, likely hidden behind a Mahogany Tree. Dig up the center.

sources.label: Bush West of Parrot Express Bridge
sources.description: From the farm's Parrot Express station, go west over the bridge across the river. Find a walnut bush partially hidden by the southern wall.

sources.label: Simon Says Cave Puzzle
sources.description: Complete the Simon Says puzzle in the cave north of Tiger Slime Grove. Rewards 3 walnuts.

sources.label: Bush at Eastern Cliff Edge
sources.description: Go east from the Tiger Slime Grove and follow the cliff edge, destroying any rocks or weeds. A walnut bush is at the end of the path.

sources.label: Buried: Diamond Pebbles (Parrot Express East)
sources.description: East of the farm's Parrot Express station, dig the center of the diamond-shaped pebbles.

sources.label: Bush at End of Eastern Hidden Path
sources.description: East of the farm's Parrot Express station, follow the hidden path that jogs east then north. A walnut bush is at the far end.

sources.label: Bush on South Cliff (Farmhouse View)
sources.description: South of the farm's Parrot Express station, go south along the cliff and bend east overlooking the farmhouse. Walnut bush at the end.

sources.label: Buried: Stone Circle at Entrance (West)
sources.description: Atop the stairs at Island North entrance, turn west and dig at the center of the stone circle.

sources.label: Grove Bush (Hidden Passage West)
sources.description: Atop the stairs at Island North entrance, take the hidden western passage to reach a secluded grove with a walnut bush.

sources.label: Buried: First Flower Circle (NE of Entrance)
sources.description: Atop the Island North stairs, go northeast to the grassy area and dig at the center of the circle of flowers.

sources.label: Buried: Second Flower Circle (Further East)
sources.description: From the first flower circle, go east to another grassy area and dig at the center of a second circle of flowers.

sources.label: Buried: Sand Patch (SE of Field Office)
sources.description: Southeast of the Island Field Office, find the patch of sand with unusual texture and dig for the buried walnut.

sources.label: Buried: Stone Circle at Dig Site
sources.description: Up the north steps of the dig site, dig at the center of the stone circle.

sources.label: Bush West of Dig Site
sources.description: Up the north steps of the dig site, cross the bridge west to find a walnut plant.

sources.label: Two Bushes East of Dig Site 1/2
sources.description: Up the north steps of the dig site, go east through a hidden passage in the cliff. Cross the bridge and find two walnut plants beyond it.

sources.label: Two Bushes East of Dig Site 2/2
sources.description: Up the north steps of the dig site, go east through a hidden passage in the cliff. Cross the bridge and find two walnut plants beyond it.

sources.label: Field Office: Large Animal Collection
sources.description: Donate all Large Animal skeleton pieces to the Island Field Office (center skeleton, snake bones). Completing this collection rewards 6 walnuts.

sources.label: Field Office: Snake Collection
sources.description: Donate all snake skeleton pieces to the Island Field Office. Completing this collection rewards 3 walnuts.

sources.label: Field Office: Mummified Frog
sources.description: Donate a Mummified Frog to the Island Field Office.

sources.label: Field Office: Mummified Bat
sources.description: Donate a Mummified Bat to the Island Field Office.

sources.label: Field Office: Purple Flowers Survey
sources.description: Complete the Purple Flowers Island Survey at the Field Office. The correct answer is 22.

sources.label: Field Office: Purple Starfish Survey
sources.description: Complete the Purple Starfish Island Survey at the Field Office. The correct answer is 18.

sources.label: Bush SE of Volcano Entrance
sources.description: Southeast of the Volcano Dungeon's entrance, find the walnut plant hidden by a tree.

sources.label: Buried: Sand Circle by Volcano
sources.description: Eastward from the Volcano Dungeon entrance, dig in the sand circled by two bushes and an arc of stones.

sources.label: Tree Nut (Slingshot Required)
sources.description: Northeast of the Volcano Dungeon entrance, find a curved tree protruding from the side of the Volcano. Knock down the walnut using a Slingshot.

sources.label: Buried: Curved Palm (SW of Volcano)
sources.description: Journal Scrap #10: Southwest of the Volcano Dungeon's entrance, find a curved palm tree growing from the cliff's side. Dig the tile visible just inside the loop of the palm tree. (Yields nothing without the journal scrap.)

sources.label: Buried: Stone Circle at NW Corner
sources.description: Dig at the center of the circle of stones at the extreme northwest of the map, where Leo sometimes stands.

sources.label: Bush in NW Hidden Passage
sources.description: At the extreme northwest of the map, west of the volcano, proceed west along the wall and north through a hidden passage. Find a walnut in the secluded bush.

sources.label: Lava Secret Area (Watering Can) 1/2
sources.description: At the lava river at the Volcano Dungeon entrance, use a Watering Can to create a path westward and south to a landing near the river's end. Exit the lava and collect 2 walnuts from the landing.

sources.label: Lava Secret Area (Watering Can) 2/2
sources.description: At the lava river at the Volcano Dungeon entrance, use a Watering Can to create a path westward and south to a landing near the river's end. Exit the lava and collect 2 walnuts from the landing.

sources.label: Volcano Dungeon: Mining
sources.description: Mine rocks inside the Volcano Dungeon for a chance to find Golden Walnuts. Up to 5 total.

sources.label: Volcano Dungeon: Monster Drops
sources.description: Kill monsters inside the Volcano Dungeon for a chance to find Golden Walnuts. Up to 5 total.

sources.label: Volcano Dungeon: Barrels/Crates
sources.description: Break barrels and crates inside the Volcano Dungeon for a chance to find Golden Walnuts. Up to 5 total.

sources.label: Volcano Dungeon: Normal Chest
sources.description: Open the normal chest in the Volcano Dungeon.

sources.label: Volcano Dungeon: Rare Chest
sources.description: Open the rare chest in the Volcano Dungeon.

sources.label: Forge Entrance Bush
sources.description: Find the walnut plant at the entrance to the Forge (top of Volcano Dungeon).

sources.label: Forge Exit Bush
sources.description: Find the walnut plant at the exit of the Forge.

sources.label: Island South Upper Cliff
sources.description: Go up the stairs to Island North, immediately turn east, then go south through a hidden route behind a tree to access the walnut bush on the upper cliff of Island South.

sources.label: Island SE: Starfish Tide Pool Fishing
sources.description: Fish in the starfish-shaped tide pool on Island Southeast (requires beach resort to be built). The first cast here yields a Golden Walnut.

sources.label: Buried: Yellow Starfish Diamond (Island SE)
sources.description: On Island Southeast, find a diamond of yellow starfish and dig up the center.

sources.label: Mermaid Puzzle
sources.description: On a rainy day, go to Island Southeast. Place a Flute Block on each of the five rocks matching the notes indicated by the mermaid. Rewards 5 walnuts.

sources.label: Pirate Cove: Darts
sources.description: Visit the Pirate Cove (accessible after beach resort) on a non-rainy night after 8 PM on an even day. Win a round of darts for a walnut prize, up to 3 times.

sources.label: Buried: Pirate Cove Sand
sources.description: In the Pirate Cove, dig up the patch of exposed sand among the barrels east of the water.
